Aún no has creado códigos

Crea un código para que tu visita pase por la caseta sin esperar.
components.css: .ds-vacio{max-width:420px;padding:56px 24px;border-radius:28px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0/.04),0 8px 24px -12px rgb(0 0 0/.12);text-align:center;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Inter Variable','Segoe UI',sans-serif}.ds-vacio-ico{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:20px;background:rgba(38,112,72,.12);color:#267048}.ds-vacio h2{margin:24px 0 0;font-size:22px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-0.015em;color:#1D1D1F}.ds-vacio p{margin:8px auto 0;max-width:34ch;font-size:17px;line-height:1.6;color:#6A6A70}

components.name: Barra superior translúcida
components.css: .ds-barra{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;height:56px;padding:0 20px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.72);-webkit-backdrop-filter:saturate(180%) blur(20px);backdrop-filter:saturate(180%) blur(20px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(29,29,31,.08);font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Inter Variable','Segoe UI',sans-serif}.ds-barra b{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:#1D1D1F}.ds-barra span{font-size:12px;color:#6A6A70}
